text.p: Italian debt instruments closed around day's highs, despite weaker German Bunds, as the market began to see signs of optimism over an EMU stability pact.
Traders said they noted signals of a more accommodating attitude on the part of Germany to the single European currency.

"Germany's wish to reach an accord on the stability pact seems clear. This and hopes for a big step forward at the Amsterdam EU summit is fuelling the rise in Btps," one trader said. "If this kind of German willingness continues we could see the Btp contract at 131.00, but not much higher," he added.
The market was optimistic but very nervous, traders said.
